description:
Find an exact session_id before recovery, closing or a handoff. Unlike engram_rehydrate, this lists bounded metadata without replaying journal content or changing a session. Returns JSON sessions with member/client attribution, status, activity and checkpoint availability, plus next_cursor.

Default scope=mine lists this member's sessions; scope=workspace explicitly includes teammates in the authenticated workspace. repo/status/agent_tool/member_id filter results; a teammate member_id requires workspace scope. limit defaults to 20, maximum 50. Pass next_cursor unchanged to continue newest-started-first pagination. Empty results are valid. Consumes daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read.

agent_tool.description: Calling client name for attribution, e.g. codex, claude-code, cursor, or gemini. Omit if unknown.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the prior response. Keep filters unchanged; omit for the first page.

member_id.description: Member id to filter; another member requires scope=workspace. This is a filter, not authorization.

repo.description: Repository slug, e.g. engram or billing-api, within the authenticated workspace. This is a memory filter, not a filesystem path or workspace selector.

scope.description: Default mine lists your sessions across clients; workspace includes shared teammate session metadata.

status.description: Filter journal state; omit to include both active and closed sessions.

name: engram_list_sessions

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: List Sessions
